install_dependency: synfig CLI (Arch package synfig); python-pillow; ffmpeg with libvpx-vp9
limitations: Saved root canvas only; unpack .sfg into a self-contained .sif bundle first
External canvas links, symlinks and assets outside bundle are rejected
System fonts and renderer modules are runtime dependencies, not bundled assets
version_note: Queried inside the bounded render job; discovery does not launch the renderer
